meta.source: Chrome DevTools AI Assistance export, 2026-09-30 — computed styles read from one live page

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Measured. Panel and card surfaces (--color-panel). Pair with a 1px line border; no shadow.

tokens.name: panel-deep
tokens.usage: Inferred, not measured — the class bg-panel-deep exists on hover states, its value was never read. Hover and focus fill for nav links and icon buttons. Confirm before shipping.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Inferred — DevTools guessed this hex; only the token name (--color-line) was confirmed. Panel borders and the header divider (border-b). Hairline strength only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Measured (rgb 14,17,22). Primary text, active icons, titles. On panel: ~18:1.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Measured (rgb 85,92,105). Secondary text, inactive icons, small labels. On panel: ~6.6:1, safe at 12px. Hover shifts to ink.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Measured (text-title-sm, H1). One per view. Tight leading, about 1.15.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Measured (H2, mt-6 first:mt-0). Section breaks inside a panel body.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Body copy sits at fifteen pixels with a 1.6 line height.
styles.usage: Measured (.9375rem / 1.6). The default for everything inside a panel.

styles.name: label-strong
styles.usage: Measured (text-sm font-semibold). Strong labels, list titles.

styles.name: caption-strong
styles.usage: Measured (H2 in panel headers, text-ink). Panel header titles.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Measured (text-xs font-medium text-muted). Wayfinding labels, in muted.

spacing.note: Base unit --spacing: 0.25rem (4px), measured. Every step is calc(var(--spacing) * n).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The base unit (--spacing). Never used alone in what was measured; exists to multiply.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Measured. Gap between items in a panel header (gap-x-2).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Measured. Panel header right inset (pr-3); nav link horizontal padding (px-3).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Measured. Panel body padding on all sides (p-4). The default whitespace.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Measured. Space above a section heading (mt-6), removed on the first one.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Inferred — the class rounded-control exists on links and buttons, its value was never read. Controls. Confirm before shipping.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Measured. Nav and UI icons, filled, color from ink or muted. Always shrink-0.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Measured. Stroked utility icons at 1.7px stroke, muted.

tokens.name: hit-min
tokens.usage: Measured (min-h-11 min-w-11). Minimum icon-button target; nav rows use 48px (min-h-12) on mobile.
